hpi: The patient is a 65-year-old male with abdominal pain. The patient has a history of diverticulitis and presents with fever and leukocytosis. The patient was treated with IV fluids and antibiotics. The patient was admitted for further management. The patient improved with conservative management and was discharged home on a clear liquid diet. Follow-up was arranged with the primary care physician.
